deviation_verdicts.constraint_values_280_200_600_no_numeral: ACCEPT for AI.2, CONFIRM WITH MARK. The sim must emit constraints and the design gives only the 280 example; the values are centralised (maxCharsFor, openRequest) and tested, so changing them is a one-line edit plus a test. Points for Mark: (1) no_numerals is true for every purpose including archive and news, where dates and distances may be wanted; (2) 200 chars for an M4 arrival news item may be tight; (3) emotions defaults to all 8 when the relay omits the list, whereas design (b) says the request should list the emotions the person actually has in the layers, so the relay must send it explicitly for portrait fallback to mean anything.
deviation_verdicts.cache_key_variant_0_images_dash_text_voi: ACCEPT, with an AI.3 note. It matches the design's own ai_request example ('variant':'-' for text). Design (a4) defines the stored variant for voice/text as 16 hex of a sha256 that only exists after generation, so the request key cannot carry it; AI.3's ai_descriptor check ('its key != the request's key') must therefore compare all fields except variant for text/voice, or the first real record will be refused.
deviation_verdicts.line_req_handling: ACCEPT. Voice without line_req -> ai_stale (it is 'not among the last 64 accepted lines'); line_req on a non-voice kind -> ai_bad_key. Both tested; both are the stricter reading and keep the relay honest.
deviation_verdicts.record_unsupported_until_AI3: ACCEPT. Plan task 7 keeps IRecord unsupported; the honest consequence is that checkCommittedRefusesAll expects 7:unsupported rather than an acceptance. Note the M2 doc amendment already says record is 'accepted while committed'; true once AI.3 lands, so AI.3 must not slip without revisiting that sentence.
deviation_verdicts.ai_section_only_on_change: ACCEPT. Follows M2's change-set rule (whole section, present when changed) and is what keeps 2.0 logs byte-identical; full states gain it with the AI.3 minor bump. Transitional quirk: a client that sends AI intents before AI.3 gets an ai key in a minor-0 stream; no client does.
deviation_verdicts.toml_export_addition: ACCEPT. Required to import ./ai; one-line change, merges cleanly with AI.1's markers entry.
